query: Mande dos mensajes seguidos a la otra sesion. El primero dijo delivered y el segundo, un segundo despues, dijo 'side b has no listener'. Se cayo el peer?
expected_behavior: explain that the peer's keeper re-attaches for a few seconds after every delivery (measured ~5 s over ssh), so the marker is momentarily absent
state that pp --send waits up to PP_SEND_GRACE (10 s) for the reader before refusing; an older sender build refuses instantly, so retry after a few seconds
warn against --force here (it skips the check and blocks for the full send timeout if the peer really is gone)
notes: The refusal right after a delivery is the keeper's gap, not an absent peer.
